summary: An addendum covering advanced Agentic Design and Ops patterns, ensuring no gaps in the interview prep. It covers Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval flows, Memory Architectures (Episodic/Semantic/Procedural), Durable Execution (Temporal/LangGraph Cloud) for stateful agents, advanced AgentOps telemetry (OpenTelemetry, AgentOps framework), and deterministic testing for agents.
